consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if any Marathon provider configuration remains in the static configuration.

original.statement: The Marathon provider has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and Marathon-related configuration is no longer supported.

decision.reason: [ev-c71146d39072] says the Marathon provider was removed in v3, and that v2 Marathon configuration (providers.marathon in YAML or TOML, or --providers.marathon on the CLI) "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". It also says all Marathon provider configuration must be removed from the static configuration. If the upgraded Traefik won't start, the upgrade fails because a precondition isn't met. That fits upgrade-blocked, which is action-required, and the severity of critical is reasonable when the proxy can't start at all.
